sections.section_title: HPDMA channels with peripheral early termination
sections.text_helper: Section 18.3.6 "HPDMA channels with peripheral early termination" in chapter 18 (High-performance direct memory access controller (HPDMA)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 840.
sections.section_content:
An HPDMA channel, if implemented with this feature, can support the early termination of
the data transfer from the peripheral which does also support this feature.
[Table 88. HPDMA1 channel with peripheral early termination]
This HPDMA support is activated when the channel x is programmed with
HPDMA_CxTR2.PFREQ=1. Then, the peripheral itself can initiate and request a data
transfer completion, before the HPDMA has transferred the whole block
(seeSection18.4.14 for more details).
[Table 89. Programmed HPDMA1 request with peripheral early termination]
